content: incident-bot: P1 alert — Sequoia Health (private-vpc: sequoia-prod) experiencing egress failures to customer NLB; ~40% of inference calls 502/504. Paging on-call.
messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — Sequoia Health (private-vpc: sequoia-prod) experiencing egress failures to customer NLB; ~40% of inference calls 502/504. Paging on-call.

alice.ops: @bob-sre you got the pager? seeing spike in 5xx and NLB healthcheck flapping.

bob-sre: oncall here, jumping in. starting quick triage: checking runtime logs & NLB target health. can someone attach the runbook link?

alice.ops: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-vpc-egress

bob-sre: quick check: nginx downstream shows TLS handshake timeouts to 10.10.30.0/24 NLB targets. tcpdump on host shows SYNs leaving but no SYN-ACK back. suspect SG or path. running: 
```
sudo tcpdump -n host 10.10.30.45 and port 443 -c 20
14:02:11.123456 IP 172.20.5.12.54321 > 10.10.30.45.443: S, seq 12345, win 64240
14:02:11.223789 IP 172.20.5.12.54321 > 10.10.30.45.443: S, seq 12346, win 64240
# no replies seen
```

claire-net: looking at VPC flow logs for sequoia-prod-nb: I see DENY records to the NLB IPs starting ~13:58 UTC. Also noticed a recent terraform apply at 13:55 that modified security group sg-0a1b2c3d — removing ephemeral outbound rule for health probes. pulling the change diff now.

claire-net: diff snippet: 
```diff
-  egress { cidr_blocks = ["10.10.0.0/16"] protocol = "tcp" from_port = 0 to_port = 0 }
+  # removed broad egress to internal tenant CIDR (was too permissive)
```

bob-sre: that would explain; NLB health checks come from nodes in tenant CIDR. can we re-open just the healthcheck ports temporarily? prefer a least-privilege allow to specific healthcheck IPs.

claire-net: agree. I can authorize security group ingress to allow 443 from the NLB healthcheck IPs and add back ephemeral egress to the control-plane subnet as a short-lived workaround. planning to run: 
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d \
  --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.10.30.0/24 --profile sequoia-prod
# and then re-apply a narrower egress for 10.10.30.0/24:443
```

alice.ops: @emily-cs please notify Sequoia that we're applying an emergency config change that may be reverted after validation. ask if they want a weighted DNS failover while we patch infra.

emily-cs: pinging sequoia-support — will update them now. Sequoia says prefer no DNS cutover currently; they want minimal config change. they asked for ETA 15-30m.

bob-sre: executing the SG change now. will also mark NLB targets healthy if they start responding.

claire-net: SG rule added, commit: sg-0a1b2c3d now allows 10.10.30.0/24:443 inbound. applying egress narrow allow.

bob-sre: re-checking tcpdump after change: 
```
14:08:02.345678 IP 172.20.5.12.54321 > 10.10.30.45.443: S, seq 12347
14:08:02.345889 IP 10.10.30.45.443 > 172.20.5.12.54321: S, ack 12348
# SYN-ACKs returned, NLB targets now responding
```

bob-sre: NLB target health improved: healthy_count went from 1/3 -> 3/3 over 90s. traffic back to normal, error rate dropping.

alice.ops: good. leaving SG change in place as temporary mitigation. Need a safe rollback plan and IaC fix.

claire-net: creating a short-lived security policy with a tag "temporary-mitigation/sequoia-4861234567" and TTL 2h. will also push a commit to terraform to re-introduce a narrowly-scoped rule referencing explicit healthcheck IP set and add a reconciliation test.

emily-cs: Sequoia acknowledged the change and confirmed their requests are succeeding. thanks for the quick response.

bob-sre: root cause: an IaC hardening change removed internal tenant CIDR egress that NLB healthchecks depended on. mitigation: re-add narrow ingress for healthchecks + IaC rollback with smaller scope.

alice.ops: next steps:
- claire-net to open PR for IaC fix and include test to run NLB healthcheck simulation
- bob-sre to run post-incident verification, check for conntrack exhaustion on hosts (conntrack count low)
- emily-cs to schedule intro call with Sequoia to review runbook and approve targeted healthcheck IP allowlist
- postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC in #incidents-review

claire-net: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/terraform/changes/PR-2345 — adding allowlist and regtest, marking as hotfix.

bob-sre: quick sanity: conntrack entries before/after fix: 
```bash
# before mitigation: conntrack -L | wc -l -> 42k (close to threshold)
# after mitigation: conntrack -L | wc -l -> 12k
```

alice.ops: great. marking incident as resolved for customer impact. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

sequoia-support: thanks everyone — mitigation worked. we'll monitor and report back if we see regressions.

incident-bot: Incident P1 status -> RESOLVED (duration 00:12:40). Postmortem assigned to claire-net and bob-sre.
thread_summary: Sequoia Health private VPC egress failures; SG removal during IaC hardening blocked NLB healthchecks; temporary SG allow added, NLB recovered, IaC PR opened, postmortem scheduled.
